verdict.rationale: The only documented bulk action is the Dashboard's CSV export of all or a subset of invoices. That is a genuine multi-item operation, but it is read-only. The API, MCP server and CLI are building blocks that could be used to script bulk work, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: bulk mutating actions (bulk send, finalize, void or mark uncollectible), a batch or bulk API endpoint, agent-driven bulk workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can export all of your invoices or a subset of them as a CSV file by clicking Export on the Invoices page.
